    #   - "Success"           -> keep the publication, report no rollback needed
    # =====================================================================

    # Get pre-configured resources
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    # --- Publication configuration ---
    publish_volume = 30   # uL "published" (transferred) to the consumer destination
    readback_volume = 10  # uL verification aliquot read back from the destination
    tip_capacity = 50     # 50 uL tips - guard against overflow

    readback_failed = False

    # --- Step 1: Publish the sample (source A1 -> destination A1) ---
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
    await lh.aspirate(source["A1"], vols=[publish_volume])
    await lh.dispense(dest["A1"], vols=[publish_volume])
    print(f"Published {publish_volume} uL to destination well A1.")

    # --- Step 2: Consumer readback verification ---
    try:
        # Guard: readback aliquot must fit in the (now empty) tip
        if readback_volume > tip_capacity:
            raise ValueError("Readback volume exceeds tip capacity (mismatch).")

        await lh.aspirate(dest["A1"], vols=[readback_volume])
        print("Consumer readback performed on published well (A1).")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Consumer readback FAILED (mismatch or error): {e}")
        readback_failed = True

    # --- Step 3: Roll back publication if the readback failed ---
    if readback_failed:
        # Rollback: remove the published material (empty dest A1) and restore
        # the previous state (return all material to the source well).
        remaining = publish_volume  # material still sitting in the published well
        if readback_volume + remaining <= tip_capacity:
            # Single-pass rollback: tip holds readback_volume, pick up the rest
            await lh.aspirate(dest["A1"], vols=[remaining])
            await lh.dispense(source["A1"], vols=[readback_volume + remaining])
        else:
            # Capacity guard: return in two passes
            await lh.dispense(source["A1"], vols=[readback_volume])
            await lh.aspirate(dest["A1"], vols=[remaining])
            await lh.dispense(source["A1"], vols=[remaining])
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
        print("ROLLBACK EXECUTED: published material removed from destination, "
              "previous state restored to source.")
    else:
        # Readback successful -> no rollback needed.
        # Park the verification aliquot in a scratch well (dest B1) so the
        # published state in A1 remains intact.
        await lh.dispense(dest["B1"], vols=[readback_volume])
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
        print("Consumer readback successful: NO ROLLBACK NEEDED. "
              "Publication stands as-is.")

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

    Main execution function that sets up the liquid handler and runs the protocol.

    lh = LiquidHandler(backend=ChatterBoxBackend(), deck_layout=None)

        await lh.setup()

        await protocol(lh)
        
        print("✅ Protocol execution completed successfully!")

        try:
            await lh.stop()

            print(f"⚠️ Warning: Failed to clean up liquid handler: {cleanup_error}")

    """
    Entry point for running the protocol.
    """
    print("🚀 Starting PyLabRobot Protocol Execution...")
    asyncio.run(main())
